Acid.intrinsicPredicate: A printed innate attack, secretion or power that produces acid/corrosion.

Cold.intrinsicPredicate: A printed innate attack, physiology or power that produces cold/freezing.

Fire.intrinsicPredicate: A printed innate attack, physiology or power that produces fire/heat.

Lightning.intrinsicPredicate: A printed innate attack, physiology or power that produces electricity/lightning; thunder alone is insufficient.

Poison.intrinsicPredicate: A printed innate venom/toxin production or poison-delivery ability.

Water.intrinsicPredicate: An expressly aquatic body/habitat profile, intrinsic swimming movement mode or intrinsic underwater-breathing trait; ordinary ability to attempt swimming is insufficient.

Earth.intrinsicPredicate: A printed earth/stone body trait or intrinsic movement through soil/stone.

Flora.intrinsicPredicate: Actual Plant creature type or explicitly botanical/fungal anatomy.

Arcane.intrinsicPredicate: Intrinsic expressly magical creature nature, innate spellcasting or an explicitly magical native power, regardless of casting tradition.

Psychic.intrinsicPredicate: An intrinsic expressly psychic attack or native thought-reading, memory, mental-command or telepathic ability. Mere intelligence/sentience is insufficient.

Unholy.intrinsicPredicate: Actual Undead type, an intrinsic necrotic power or an innate effect expressly operating as a curse. Fiend, “evil,” a spirit-name or an ingredient label alone is insufficient.

Stealth.intrinsicPredicate: Explicit intrinsic Stealth proficiency or a native concealment/hiding feature. A temporary decision to hide is insufficient.

Strength.intrinsicPredicate: An actual intrinsic Strength score of at least **16**, before temporary borrowed modifiers. This threshold is a NEW mechanical mapping, not an inferred species statistic.

Vitality.intrinsicPredicate: An explicit native regeneration or bodily self-recovery trait. Merely being alive, having high HP or receiving outside healing is insufficient.

It offers 3 in equipment.fishing-extra-recovery, separately compared at secure capture among sources that qualified at the check and still qualify. The first secure capture records one recovery evaluation for that physical creature, including zero; later recapture cannot raise it. Authorize only available disjoint real reserve units for later lawful harvesting, never immediate meat or extra creatures. Its one selectable attraction affinity is Psychic; choose one source before one finite, weighted response allocation within 30 feet of connected water path. Local availability, perception, response and physical fit remain required. The three choices are independent; tags never combine automatically. The complete item must have positive structural HP, remain unsuppressed and unmelded, and actually participate in the registered method. It is reusable, but supplies no bait/chum or new opportunity. Neither case grants a separate activation, RP, concentration, charges, proficiency, AC candidate, resistance, food credit or bonus on harvesting, repair, research, creation or combat.
